column1: # A TARGET is not a CLAIM — must-match / must-not-match case table.
# This predicate SUPPRESSES B4, so its two polarities fail in opposite directions and
# both are expensive. A miss reds a line stating a bar ("the decode ratio must be
# >= 1.0x llama.cpp" is a threshold, and a threshold is allowed to be a constant —
# that is what a bar IS). A spurious match silently EXEMPTS a published claim, which
# is the never-ran-Ollama defect with a permission slip.
# Same spelling as check_no_claim_literals.sh's TARGET_RE, for the same reason the
# ratio pattern is: two drifting definitions of "this is only a target" is how one of
# them ends up blessing a claim the other bans.
